description: List the JSONata functions and values a model's library exports — what an expression in this model may call, with signature, arity and originating layer. Call it before writing an expression so you reuse the model's existing vocabulary instead of re-deriving it. Returns null when the model declares no library.
name: get_library

description.description: The library's prose description, if any.

exports.description: One entry per exported name: {name, kind ('function'|'constant'), signature, arity, origin}.

title: Get model library
